verdict.rationale: Notte's marketing site claims "Live View & Replays" with session playback, which is the core of replay-based debugging. The docs, however, only describe a live ViewerUrl for watching a session as it runs, not recorded replays. Missing for 10: documented video replay retrieval for past or failed runs, per-step screenshots, step-by-step action timelines, and any hands-on or independent corroboration of replay debugging.

support.subject: As an automation-engineer, I can debug a failed agent run from recorded replays — video, screenshots, step-by-step action timelines

citations.quote: Live View & Replays Screenshare & session playback
the output includes a `ViewerUrl` - open it to watch your browser live
